stages.name: Accounts, PDAs and moving SOL
stages.blurb: How programs store state, how addresses are derived from seeds, and how SOL and tokens move. Start here if you are new to Solana programs.

stages.name: Authorization and the checks that go missing
stages.blurb: has_one, PDA signing, multisig and roles — and how to read a program for the account check that isn't there. Several of these apps have real, proven bugs.

stages.name: Markets, staking and oracles
stages.blurb: The building blocks put to work: deadlines, curves, fees, rewards that grow with time, and who is allowed to publish a result.
